title: finding(types): the TS root barrel names neither `InputShorthandSchema` nor `UiCalendarSchema`, while `./zod` now names both — a ruling is owed on the second barrel
body:
Filed from the objectui#9067 implementation run (PR #9405, which lands the ruling that names `InputShorthandSchema` and `UiCalendarSchema` on the `@object-ui/types/zod` barrel), by the `os-dev` seat on branch `claude/issue-9067-zod-barrel-named-arms`, session `session_011QreXiyMEqKLN4U5daMPVa`. Filed unassigned and ungraded — `domain:*`, type and priority are the triage seat's.

⛔ Not ridden onto PR #9405. objectui#9067's ruling names exactly one file, `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`. Adding names to a **second** published barrel is a separate Clause-2 act on a surface no one has ruled on, and that dispatch says stop and report.

## The reading

`packages/types/src/index.ts` — the **TypeScript root barrel**, a different published surface from the zod barrel — re-exports 28 of the 30 interfaces `src/form.ts` exports. The two it does not name are exactly the two objectui#9067 just ruled nameable on the zod side:

| name | `@object-ui/types` (root) | `@object-ui/types/form` (subpath) | `@object-ui/types/zod` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `InputShorthandSchema` | **absent** | present | named by PR #9405 |
| `UiCalendarSchema` | **absent** | present | named by PR #9405 |
| `CalendarSchema` (control, same list) | present | present | present |

Probe, run from `packages/core` (a package that links `@object-ui/types`), against the built package, `moduleResolution: bundler`:

```
probe.ts(1,15): error TS2724: '"@object-ui/types"' has no exported member named 'UiCalendarSchema'. Did you mean 'CalendarSchema'?
probe.ts(2,15): error TS2724: '"@object-ui/types"' has no exported member named 'InputShorthandSchema'. Did you mean 'InputOTPSchema'?
```

⭐ **Both controls in the same compilation pass**, which is what makes this a reading rather than a broken probe: line 3 imports `UiCalendarSchema` from `@object-ui/types/form` and line 4 imports `CalendarSchema` from the root, and **neither errors**. So the root entry resolves, the neighbour on the very same re-export list resolves, and only these two names are missing. The same asymmetry is visible in the built artifact without a compiler: `dist/index.d.ts` carries zero occurrences of either name, `dist/form.d.ts` carries five.

An earlier run of this probe from the repository root reported `TS2307` on all four lines including the control — no resolution at all — and is reported here as **void rather than omitted**, because a probe whose control fails measures nothing.

## ⛔ This is NOT the objectui#8499 deferral recurring on another surface

Stated explicitly, because the card this one follows was framed that way and the framing was wrong there too. Ruling item 4 of objectui#9067's record is the instrument, and it was run before this was written:

```
git grep -n InputShorthandSchema -- .changeset
git grep -n "index.ts|root barrel" -- .changeset
```

The first returns `.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md` and `.changeset/8784-arm-named-export-pin.md`. **Both are about the zod barrel only** — 8499's deferral passage reasons about `@object-ui/types/zod`, the `unexportedNodeSchemas` metric it moves is defined as "no schema for them is exported by name from `@object-ui/types/zod`", and 8784 is the pin over that same barrel. The second query surfaces no changeset deferring these two names from the TS root barrel. ⇒ Unlike the zod side, **no record was found declaring this one**, and this card claims exactly that and no more: a search that found nothing, not a proof that nothing was decided.

Note also that the *reason* the zod ruling gave for not naming the two FAMILY schemas does not transfer here as-is: the objection was that a `z.enum` family schema publishes a different authoring contract from a barrel where one name means one node type. Whether the TS root barrel carries that same meaning is part of what is being asked, not something this card assumes.

## Precedent — the same shape, already ruled once, on this same list

objectui#7697 is this defect for a sibling name, and its changeset states the pattern in as many words:

> `import type { ComboboxOption } from '@object-ui/types'` now compiles; on the previous release it read `TS2305` while its two siblings on the same list resolved.

It also records that reaching a name only through the `/form` subpath can be a **deliberate, sound** choice ("the subpath is a house pattern"), which is why this card asks for a ruling rather than asserting a repair.

## What is being asked

A ruling, one for both names:

- **(a)** add both to the root barrel's existing named re-export list from `./form.js`, additively, next to `InputSchema` and `CalendarSchema` — the objectui#7697 route; or
- **(b)** declare the root barrel deliberately partial for these two, with the reason written where it is re-read rather than in a changeset that a release consumes.

Cost of (a): two more names on a published surface, hence Clause-2. Cost of (b): the zod barrel names a schema whose TypeScript counterpart the root barrel does not, and nothing in the tree says why.

⚠️ Deliberately **not** widened to the other two objectui#8499 arms: `SemanticElementSchema` and `HtmlElementSchema` have TS counterparts in `src/layout.ts` that the root barrel also omits, but objectui#9067 just ruled those two absent by decision on the zod side, so their TS counterparts raise a different question and should not ride on this one.

## Dedup

The 100 most recently updated **open** issues were listed over the repository-scoped REST issues endpoint and grepped locally for `root barrel`, `index.ts`, `TS2305`, `InputShorthandSchema`, `UiCalendarSchema`, `type counterpart`, `mirror-parity`, `types/form` and `root spelling`. Live reader, control run in the same pass: 92 of the 100 bodies contain `objectui`, so the corpus was actually read. Substantive hits are objectui#9067 itself and PR #9405; none claims this. **Bounded honestly:** this is a recency-window read of open issues, not a full-corpus search, and the search endpoint was not used.

Refs: objectui#9067 (the zod-barrel ruling this follows) · PR #9405 (its implementation) · objectui#7697 (the same defect for `ComboboxOption`, with its repair) · objectui#8499 (the card that armed all four arms) · objectui#8784 (the zod-barrel pin)

Written by the ObjectStack `os-dev` agent seat with Claude Code; session `session_011QreXiyMEqKLN4U5daMPVa`.
